title: Mini whiteboards that actually tell you something
hook: Mini whiteboards can turn a quiet class into one where every student answers every question. They can also turn into a drawing session. The routine makes the difference.
coreIdeaMd:
A simple routine:

1. **Ask** the question. Give a short thinking time (count to five in your head).
2. **"Show me"**: every board goes up at the same time, facing you.
3. **Scan** for patterns, not individuals. Say what you see: "Most of you have 3x, a few have x + 3."
4. **Boards down, wipe.** Then respond to what you saw.

Keep questions short. Mini whiteboards are for quick answers, not full working.

checkItems.stemMd: Why should every board go up at the same time?
options: So students can't copy, and you see the whole class at once
So you can mark them later
checkItems.answer: So students can't copy, and you see the whole class at once
checkItems.feedbackCorrect: Yes. Holding up together gives you honest information from everyone.
checkItems.feedbackIncorrect: Holding up together stops copying and lets you read the whole room in one look.

tryTomorrow: Use mini whiteboards for three quick questions at the start of tomorrow's lesson. Say aloud what pattern you see each time.
reflectPrompt: What did you notice about who answers questions in your class when you don't use whiteboards?
